title: 第21章 如果换个地方进入内景世界第22章 不同地点登录内景求追读求投资
content_zh:
;;
尾闾关、夹脊关、玉枕关……
暖和的气混合着新吸纳的寒冽灵气，艰难却坚定地沿着督脉上行，过百会，下印堂，穿喉轮，经膻中，沉入气海，完成一个完整的周天循环。
每循环一次，丹田内那点暖流就壮大一分，身体的疲惫感也减轻一分。
七个周天下来，张唯只感觉浑身暖洋洋的。
虽然新吸纳的灵气远不如最初安全屋里的充沛，但比起安全屋彻底枯竭的状态，已是天壤之别。
而且，这里的灵气似乎更浓一些，或者说更集中。
张唯缓缓收功，睁开双眼，眸子里闪过一丝疲惫，但更多的是喜悦和新的疑惑。
他环顾着这间刚刚经历过生死搏杀，曾经作为自杀现场的卧室，墙壁上还残留着银焰灼烧的痕迹和那些触目惊心的抓痕。
他猜得没错，这些由现实痛苦与死亡映射而来的鬼物盘踞之地，反而会滋生出内景世界所需的灵气。
这想法让他心头一震，却又隐隐觉得符合这内景世界的逻辑。
毕竟女鬼映射到内景世界中，在现实世界是有原型的。
兴许是极致的执念才会造就这些灵气的诞生。
也就是说，这些诡异源头，就是灵气诞生之地，而所谓的灵气，是通过怨念之类产生的？
这点还需要进一步验证，毕竟现在的遭遇还不足以作为数据支撑。
得继续深入探索才能知晓。
思索间，张唯背靠着501室冰冷布满灰尘的床架，七个周天后的修炼，让他体力得到了极大缓解。
让他没想到的是连续施展两次天罡驱邪咒的消耗远超预期，精神上的疲惫更是难以言喻。
虽然体力得到了缓解，但张唯感觉眼皮越来越沉，自己的精气神似乎也在催促他休息。
他知道不能在这里久留，走廊外危机四伏，三楼还有个邻居虎视眈眈。

心念电转间，他果断切断了与内景世界的连接，意识如同被强力橡皮筋猛地拽回现实。
“呼……”
现实世界住了十几年的屋子的熟悉味道涌入鼻腔，给他带来了一种踏实感。
张唯长长吐出一口浊气，仿佛要把肺里残留的内景污浊彻底排空。
紧接着，他敏锐地捕捉到颅脑深处那丝细微却无比真实的清凉感。
像炎夏午后一丝若有若无的穿堂风，拂过躁动的神经。
尽管微弱，但极为真实，自己在内景世界中通过小周天服气法汇聚的灵气确实反馈在了现实世界内。
脑中那颗肿瘤，在体内气的抚慰下，竟真的再次蛰伏了下去，不再像往常那样，时刻用钝痛提醒他死神的存在。
果然如此！
张唯心中既是喜悦，又是忧虑。
喜的是自己寻到了灵气，忧虑的是根据自己之前的状态，一旦开始吐纳灵气，那么后续中途中断的话，造成的反噬会更迅猛。
这是一条踏上就没办法停下的路。
悬着的心终于重重落下，砸在胸腔里发出一声无声的回响。
现在他是猜对了。
内景世界中的鬼物盘踞之所，成了内景世界灵气的源头。
鬼域滋生灵气这事儿。

Weulu Pass, Jiaji Pass, Yuzhen Pass...
The warm Qi mixed with the newly absorbed cold spiritual Qi moves up the Du Vein with difficulty but determination, passes through Baihui, descends to Yintang, passes through the Throat Chakra, passes through Shanzhong, and sinks into the Sea of Qi, completing a complete cycle of the heaven and earth.
With each cycle, the warm current in the Dantian becomes stronger and the body's fatigue becomes lighter.
After seven weeks, Zhang Wei felt warm all over.
Although the newly absorbed spiritual energy is far less abundant than that in the original safe house, it is a world of difference compared to the completely depleted state of the safe house.
Moreover, the spiritual energy here seems to be stronger, or more concentrated.
Zhang Wei slowly stopped the exercise and opened his eyes. A trace of exhaustion flashed in his eyes, but more of them were filled with joy and new doubts.
He looked around at the bedroom, which had just experienced a life-and-death struggle and had been used as a suicide scene. There were still traces of silver flames and shocking scratches on the walls.
He guessed right. The place where these ghosts reflected the pain and death of reality would breed the aura needed for the interior world.
This thought shocked him, but he felt that it was consistent with the logic of this interior world.
After all, the female ghost is mapped into the interior world and has a prototype in the real world.
Perhaps it is extreme obsession that leads to the birth of these auras.
In other words, these strange sources are the birthplace of spiritual energy, and the so-called spiritual energy is generated through resentment and the like?
This needs further verification, after all, the current experience is not enough to be supported by data.
You have to continue to explore further to find out.
While thinking, Zhang Wei leaned against the cold, dusty bed frame in Room 501. After seven weeks of practice, his physical strength was greatly relieved.
What he didn't expect was that the consumption of casting the Tiangang Exorcism Curse twice in a row was far greater than expected, and the mental exhaustion was even more indescribable.
Although his physical strength was relieved, Zhang Wei felt that his eyelids were getting heavier and heavier, and his energy seemed to be urging him to rest.
He knew he couldn't stay here for long. There were dangers outside the corridor, and there was a neighbor on the third floor who was eyeing him.
In a flash of thought, he decisively cut off the connection with the inner world, and his consciousness was jerked back to reality as if by a strong rubber band.
"Huh..."
The familiar smell of the house he had lived in for more than ten years in the real world flowed into his nose, giving him a sense of solidity.
Zhang Wei exhaled a long breath of turbid air, as if to completely empty the remaining internal filth in his lungs.
Immediately afterwards, he keenly captured the subtle but extremely real feeling of coolness deep in his skull.
Like a faint draft in the hot summer afternoon, it blows through the restless nerves.
Although weak, it is extremely real. The aura he gathered through Xiao Zhoutian's Qi Conquering Technique in the inner world is indeed fed back into the real world.
The tumor in his brain, soothed by the qi in his body, actually went dormant again. It no longer reminded him of the existence of death with dull pain as usual.
Sure enough!
Zhang Wei felt both joy and worry in his heart.
I am happy that I have found spiritual energy, but I am worried that based on my previous state, once I start to breathe out spiritual energy, if it is interrupted midway, the backlash will be even more rapid.
This is a road you can't stop on.
The hanging heart finally dropped heavily, hitting the chest with a silent echo.
Now he was right.
The place where the ghosts in the interior world reside has become the source of the aura of the interior world.
The ghost realm breeds spiritual energy.
